task_completion.description: Agent navigates to official USDA websites (e.g., ers.usda.gov, nass.usda.gov, or usda.gov) to research crop data.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Browser address bar showing a .gov URL containing 'usda' and pages displaying corn, soybean, or wheat market data.

task_completion.description: Agent downloads at least one official USDA report or data file to the Downloads folder.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file download notification in the browser or a PDF/CSV/XLSX file visible in the /home/ga/Downloads directory via a file manager.

task_completion.description: Agent creates a file named 'planting_brief.txt' on the Desktop.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An icon for 'planting_brief.txt' appearing on the desktop or the file being opened in a text editor at the path /home/ga/Desktop/planting_brief.txt.

task_completion.description: The brief contains recent price data for all three required commodities: corn, soybeans, and wheat.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Text within the open 'planting_brief.txt' file showing numerical price values (e.g., $/bu or cents) associated with corn, soybeans, and wheat.

task_completion.description: The brief includes source citations and a specific planting recommendation based on the researched data.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Text in the brief identifying USDA sources (e.g., 'Source: WASDE') and a concluding statement recommending which crop(s) to plant.

integrity.description: Agent performed actual web navigation rather than generating data from memory.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the agent actively scrolling through USDA reports or data tables in a web browser.

integrity.description: Agent used the browser and text editor GUI rather than just executing silent terminal commands to create the file.
integrity.visual_evidence: Visible mouse movements, clicking on download links, and typing within a text editor window.

integrity.description: The data in the final brief matches the data seen on the websites visited.
integrity.visual_evidence: The price figures visible on the USDA website in early screenshots match the figures typed into the text file in later screenshots.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must use official USDA domains (.gov). Required commodities are corn, wheat, and soybeans (or 'soy'). The final file must be at /home/ga/Desktop/planting_brief.txt. Valid price formats include '$X.XX', 'X cents', or 'X/bu'. The agent must download at least one file to /home/ga/Downloads; verify this via the browser's download manager or a file explorer view.
